The '''''Atgeir''-class battlecruiser''' was a [[Warship/Legends|warship]] used by [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]].

==Description==
The ''Atgeir''-class was famous for its shields, generated by crowns of dagger-like shield generators. The class was similar to the later [[Invincible-class Dreadnaught Heavy Cruiser|''Invincible''-class Dreadnaught Heavy Cruiser]].<ref name="EGW" />

==History==
Too expensive to deploy strategically against cheaper and nimbler warships, these battlecruisers were used primarily for home defense and tours of victory during the early [[Alsakan Conflicts/Legends|Alsakan Conflicts]].<ref name="EGW" />
The most modern variants of these ships were built by [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]] for the [[Seventeenth Alsakan Conflict|last]] of the [[Alsakan Conflicts/Legends|Alsakan Conflicts]],<ref name="HSCSS">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref> around [[3017 BBY]].<ref name="EA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> The battlecruiser design inspired the [[Invincible-class Dreadnaught Heavy Cruiser|''Invincible''-class Dreadnaught Heavy Cruiser]].<ref name="HSCSS" />
